name: Remove Enchantment
body:
You can enhance the strength of your healing power to target magical ailments.

Prerequisite(s): Channel positive energy, 12th-level paladin

Benefit: You can use six lay on hands attempts to channel positive energy into a cure disease spell or spell-like ability or to convert into a break enchantment spell. You make a caster check as normal to cancel a single enchantment, transmutation, curse or petrification.
